answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose a novel approach to multi-document summarization based on a neural interpretation of traditional concept-to-text generation systems.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our systems using the following automatic metrics. Rouge is an automatic metric used to compare the model output with the gold reference . KG(G) computes the number of entity-entity pairs with a relation in the gold reference, that are generated in the output. KG(I) computes the number of entity-entity pairs in the output that are present in the input scientific abstracts. Aggregation Cognisance (Ag) measures the accuracy of the model in producing outputs which are cognizant of the right aggregation

answer_4.quote: In addition to automatic evaluation, we have human annotators score our models on relevance and fluency.
answer_4.guideline: Rate relevance and fluency on a 1-4 likert scale
